note_ko: 표정 사전. main_en은 보통/상세 모두, echo_en은 상세에서 같은 표정을 다른 표현으로 한 번 더 말할 때 쓴다. {p}/{P}=her/Her.

환한 미소.desc_ko: 입꼬리가 올라가고 눈가가 반달처럼 접히는 밝은 미소
환한 미소.main_en: looking directly at the camera and smiling warmly, {p} eyes crinkled into soft half-moons, {p} lips parted in a bright natural smile showing a hint of teeth, the left corner of {p} mouth lifting first
환한 미소.echo_en: {P} smile reaches {p} eyes, the corners of {p} mouth lifted and a hint of teeth showing
환한 미소.echo2_en: A bright, open smile lights up {p} whole face, {p} cheeks lifted and the corners of {p} eyes crinkled upward

은은한 미소.main_en: looking slightly past the camera with a quiet, gentle smile, the corners of {p} mouth lifted just a little
은은한 미소.echo_en: {P} expression stays soft and calm, with a faint smile resting on {p} lips
은은한 미소.echo2_en: {P} mouth stays relaxed, with only the faintest curve at the corners of {p} lips

무표정.desc_ko: 힘을 뺀 차분한 얼굴, 시선은 또렷하게
무표정.main_en: looking slightly past the camera with a calm, relaxed face, lips softly closed and eyes steady
무표정.echo_en: {P} face is still and composed, {p} gaze steady and unhurried
무표정.echo2_en: {P} features stay smooth and untroubled, with {p} lips gently closed

장난스러운 미소.desc_ko: 한쪽 입꼬리가 먼저 올라가는 장난기 있는 미소
장난스러운 미소.main_en: looking toward the camera with a playful smile, one corner of {p} mouth lifting first and {p} eyes bright
장난스러운 미소.echo_en: {P} eyes sparkle with mischief and {p} smile tilts a little to one side
장난스러운 미소.echo2_en: {P} grin is a little crooked and teasing, brightening {p} whole face
